sentences.text: According to a Haaretz poll, a bloc led by Gadi Eisenkot would win 54 seats to Benjamin Netanyahu's 49, leaving it short of a majority without Arab parties.

sources.title: Poll: Eisenkot bloc leads Netanyahu but falls short of majority without Arab parties

sentences.text: Joint List leaders said they could back legislation barring a criminal defendant from forming a government and support a minority coalition to oust Netanyahu and Bezalel Smotrich.

sources.title: Arab alliance vows to help oust Netanyahu amid delegitimization campaign

sentences.text: Likud signed a surplus-vote agreement with Smotrich's Religious Zionist Party, while Otzma Yehudit accused Likud of sidelining Itamar Ben-Gvir.

sources.title: Netanyahu's Likud, Smotrich's RZP sign surplus-vote agreement ahead of elections

sentences.text: Bennett vowed to pass a law barring draft evaders from the security cabinet, targeting Shas leader Arye Deri over the party's stance on haredi conscription.

sources.title: Bennett vows to pass 'Deri Law' barring draft evaders from Israel's security cabinet in next gov't

sentences.text: Israel's attorney general ordered the military to resume arresting ultra-Orthodox draft evaders, after clashes over an arrested student led a United Torah Judaism lawmaker to accuse Netanyahu of persecuting Torah students.

sources.title: Israel's attorney general orders IDF to resume arresting ultra-Orthodox draft evaders
Haredim clash with police over draft dodger's arrest, leading to his release

sentences.text: An Israel Democracy Institute poll showed that 68 percent of Jewish Israelis and 32 percent of Arab Israelis consider the October 7 attacks central to their choice of party.

sources.title: Majority of Israelis view October 7 as central to their vote ahead of elections, IDI poll shows

sentences.text: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu claimed at a cabinet meeting that Hamas will attempt to carry out an attack to influence the upcoming election.

sources.title: Netanyahu: Hamas will try to attack us to influence upcoming election
